newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - April 22.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - April 22.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Tuesday:
* Wall Street shares were weaker on Monday, with the Dow Jones industrial average shedding 43.34 points to 6,660.21. The 30-year U.S. Treasury slipped 14/32, yielding 7.09 percent.
* Malaysian shares closed higher on selective bargain hunting. The key Composite Index gained 2.08 percent, 23.02 points, to 1,270.60.
* Analysts said the local market would continue to be sensitive to Wall Street's movements in the absence of firm local leads.
* Sime Darby is to form a partnership with Singapore's CAM International Holdings Ltd for an aeroponic vegetable venture.

* Promet said on Monday it had bought a 70 percent stake in South Africa's Fairoak Investment Holdings (Pvt) Ltd for 18.5 million rand ($4.1 million). Fairoak plans to develop a township covering 145 hectares in South Africa.
